The issuer shows adequate liquidity (current ratio ≈ 1.44) and currently profitable operations (net income and EBIT are positive), supporting near-term debt service capacity. However, leverage is relatively high (total liabilities about 62% of assets; liabilities-to-equity ≈ 1.9) and retained earnings are materially negative, indicating weaker long-run earnings retention despite recent profitability. Overall, this profile aligns with the lower end of investment grade risk.  
DECISION: BBB-
